question: Identify the top 5 German drivers born between 1980 and 1990 who have the shortest average fastest lap time across all races they participated in. Return their full names and average fastest lap time in seconds.

SELECT
    d."XCL_038" AS forename,
    d."XCL_039" AS surname,
    AVG(
        CAST(SUBSTR(r."XCL_088", 1, INSTR(r."XCL_088", ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r."XCL_088", INSTR(r."XCL_088", ':') + 1) AS REAL)
    ) AS avg_fastest_lap_time
FROM drivers AS d
INNER JOIN results AS r ON d."XCL_034" = r."XCL_075"
WHERE d."XCL_041" = 'German'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(d."XCL_040", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1990
  AND r."XCL_088" IS NOT NULL
  AND r."XCL_088" != ''
GROUP BY d."XCL_034", d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039"
ORDER BY avg_fastest_lap_time ASC
LIMIT 5

    AVG(r.XCL_084) AS avg_fastest_lap_time
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.XCL_034 = r.XCL_075
WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'Germany'
  AND d.XCL_040 BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1990-12-31'
  AND r.XCL_084 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.XCL_034
ORDER BY avg_fastest_lap_time ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    d."XCL_038" AS forename,
    d."XCL_039" AS surname,
    AVG(
        CAST(SUBSTR(r."XCL_088", 1, INSTR(r."XCL_088", ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r."XCL_088", INSTR(r."XCL_088", ':') + 1) AS REAL)
    ) AS avg_fastest_lap_time
FROM drivers AS d
INNER JOIN results AS r ON d."XCL_034" = r."XCL_075"
WHERE d."XCL_041" = 'German'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(d."XCL_040", 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1990
  AND r."XCL_088" IS NOT NULL
  AND r."XCL_088" != ''
GROUP BY d."XCL_034", d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039"
ORDER BY avg_fastest_lap_time ASC
LIMIT 5
